#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class TextDocumentAnalysis {
public:
    static string input(const string& str) {
        int max_len = 0;
        int words = 0;
        int len = 0;
        bool inside = false;
        for (char c : str) {
            switch (c) {
                case '(':
                    if (len > 0) {
                        if (len > max_len) max_len = len;
                        len = 0;
                    }
                    inside = true;
                    break;
                case ')':
                    if (len > 0) {
                        words++;
                        len = 0;
                    }
                    inside = false;
                    break;
                case '_':
                    if (len > 0) {
                        if (inside) words++;
                        else if (len > max_len) max_len = len;
                        len = 0;
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    len++;
                    break;
            }
        }
        if (len > 0) {
            if (inside) words++;
            else if (len > max_len) max_len = len;
        }
        return to_string(max_len) + " " + to_string(words);
    }
};

int main() {
    string discard;
    while (getline(cin, discard)) {
        string str;
        if (!getline(cin, str)) break;
        cout << TextDocumentAnalysis::input(str) << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
